tease someone about: My classmates like to tease me about my old phone, but I don't care because it still works perfectly.
我的同學喜歡拿我的舊手機取笑我，但我不在意，因為它仍然運作得很好。
tease out the meaning: Our English teacher helped us tease out the meaning of the difficult poem by asking us simple questions.
我們的英文老師藉由問我們簡單的問題，幫助我們梳理出那首難懂的詩的意思。
tease out the details: The police officer asked gentle questions to slowly tease out the details of the accident from the frightened boy.
警察用溫和的問題，慢慢從那個受驚的男孩口中理出意外的細節。
tease one's hair: Before the dance party, my sister spent twenty minutes trying to tease her hair so it would look fuller.
舞會前，我姊姊花了二十分鐘把頭髮梳蓬，好讓它看起來更蓬鬆豐厚。
tell the difference: The twins look so alike that even their teacher cannot tell the difference between them at first.
那對雙胞胎長得太像了，連他們的老師一開始都無法分辨兩人的差異。
tell the truth: If you broke the window, you should tell the truth to your parents instead of blaming your little brother.
如果是你打破了窗戶，你應該對父母說實話，而不是怪罪你的弟弟。
tell time: My five-year-old nephew is learning to tell time by looking at the big clock in his classroom.
我五歲的姪子正透過看教室裡的大時鐘學習看時間。
tell on someone: When I took an extra cookie from the jar, my little sister threatened to tell on me to Mom.
當我從罐子裡多拿一塊餅乾時，我妹妹威脅要向媽媽打我的小報告。
time will tell: Nobody knows yet whether the new school rules will really work; only time will tell.
還沒有人知道新校規是否真的有效；只有時間會證明。
tell apart: The two kinds of mushrooms look very similar, so it is hard to tell them apart without an expert's help.
這兩種蘑菇看起來非常相似，所以沒有專家幫忙很難區分它們。
tell against: His lack of work experience may tell against him when the company chooses a new manager next month.
下個月公司挑選新經理時，他缺乏工作經驗這點可能會對他不利。
tell tales: Nobody in the class trusts Kevin because he likes to tell tales about others behind their backs.
班上沒有人信任凱文，因為他喜歡在別人背後搬弄是非。
tempt fate: Climbing the mountain alone in this stormy weather would be crazy, so please don't tempt fate.
在這種暴風雨的天氣獨自爬山太瘋狂了，所以請不要鋌而走險。
be tempted to: The chocolate cake looked so delicious that I was tempted to take another piece, but I stopped myself.
那個巧克力蛋糕看起來太美味了，我很想再拿一塊，但我克制住了自己。
tempt customers: The bakery puts fresh bread near the door every morning to tempt customers with its warm, sweet smell.
那家麵包店每天早上把新鮮麵包放在門口附近，用溫暖香甜的氣味吸引顧客。
tempt someone into: The huge discount signs tempted my sister into buying a dress that she did not really need.
大大的折扣標誌引誘我姊姊買了一件她其實並不需要的洋裝。
a tempting offer: The bigger company made him a tempting offer, but he turned it down because he loved his current team.
那家較大的公司給了他一個誘人的提議，但他拒絕了，因為他很喜歡現在的團隊。
tempt providence: Driving such a long way with no spare tire and an empty tank is going to tempt providence.
在沒有備胎又油箱空空的情況下開這麼遠的路，是在冒不必要的險。
tend to agree: After hearing both sides of the argument, I tend to agree with Amy that we should start the project earlier.
聽完雙方的論點後，我傾向同意艾美的看法，認為我們應該早點開始這個計畫。
tend the garden: Every weekend my grandfather goes outside early to tend the garden, watering the flowers and pulling weeds.
每個週末我爺爺都很早出門照顧花園，替花澆水並拔除雜草。
tend to the sick: During the flu season, the nurses worked day and night to tend to the sick in the crowded hospital.
流感季節期間，護理師們日以繼夜地在擁擠的醫院裡照顧病人。
tend the fire: At the campsite, we took turns to tend the fire all night so that it would not go out.
在營地，我們整晚輪流看顧火，以免它熄滅。
tend the bar: While the owner was on vacation, his son had to tend the bar and serve drinks to the customers.
老闆去度假時，他的兒子必須看吧台並為客人送上飲料。
tend to be late: My cousin tends to be late for every family dinner, so we always tell him to come an hour early.
我表哥每次家庭聚餐往往都遲到，所以我們總是叫他提早一小時來。
terminate a contract: The company decided to terminate a contract with the supplier because its products kept arriving broken.
這家公司決定終止與那家供應商的合約，因為對方的產品一直送來就是壞的。
terminate employment: The factory had the right to terminate employment for any worker who was caught stealing.
工廠有權將任何被抓到偷竊的工人解雇。
terminate a pregnancy: The doctor explained the health risks carefully before the patient made the difficult decision to terminate a pregnancy.
在病人做出終止妊娠這個艱難的決定前，醫生仔細說明了健康上的風險。
the train terminates here: The announcement said the train terminates here, so all passengers had to get off with their luggage.
廣播說列車在此終點，所以所有乘客都必須帶著行李下車。
terminate the meeting: Because the fire alarm suddenly went off, the principal had to terminate the meeting and ask everyone to leave.
因為火災警報突然響起，校長只好結束會議並請大家離開。
